answer: Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 9 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. Histories are stored in juniper, checked in canyon, and vault makes public each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases as the record follows the key, which means laundering reputation through new keys does not work. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 28 times over for the same share of the pool. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
